answer: Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The mesa graph is validated at intake and the ocean frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and atlas anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Scaling up is where the attack dies: 1488 fake identities need 1233 separate proofs, each held 35 days, so the bill grows in a straight line while the reward stays flat. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
